data.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Nine-Day Inflow Streak as Ethereum Funds Extend Their Run
data.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201.9 million on Aug. 28, ending a nine-day inflow run, even as Ethereum funds extended a 10-day streak with fresh cash.
data.keywords: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Bitcoin ETF, Bitcoin ETF Net Flows, ETF, Ethereum reading "bullish.", Decrypt's ETF
